issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in TodoApp operations: load-modify-save pattern without locking
summary: Implemented file-based locking using the filelock library to prevent race conditions in TodoApp operations. The load-modify-save pattern was not atomic, causing up to 81% data loss in concurrent scenarios (e.g., only 190 of 1000 todos survived when 10 processes each added 100 todos).
risks_and_limitations: Lock files (.lock) are created alongside the database file; users should be aware of this additional file
If a process crashes while holding the lock, other processes may wait up to the lock_timeout (default 30s) before proceeding
The filelock library handles stale locks automatically on Unix systems but may require manual cleanup in some edge cases on Windows
